ACCOUNT_DELETE_SECTION.TITLE: Delete your Account
ACCOUNT_DELETE_SECTION.NOTE: Once you delete your account, all your data will be deleted.

CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete Account
CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Deleting your Account is irreversible. Enter your account name below to confirm you want to permanently delete it.

ACCOUNT_DELETE_SECTION.FAILURE: Could not delete account, try again!

SCHEDULED_DELETION.TITLE: Account Scheduled for Deletion
SCHEDULED_DELETION.MESSAGE_MANUAL: This account is scheduled for deletion on {deletionDate}. This was requested by an administrator. You can cancel the deletion before this date.
SCHEDULED_DELETION.MESSAGE_INACTIVITY: This account is scheduled for deletion on {deletionDate} due to account inactivity. You can cancel the deletion before this date.

ACCOUNT_ID.TITLE: Account ID
ACCOUNT_ID.NOTE: This ID is required if you are building an API based integration

TRANSLATION.TITLE: Translation
TRANSLATION.NOTE: Speak every customer's language, whatever languages your team knows.

CAPTAIN.TITLE: Captain
CAPTAIN.NOTE: Reads the whole conversation, so short replies like "ok" or "gracias" stay in the right language. Keeps your tone and formality.
CAPTAIN.BILLING: Uses Captain credits from your plan

GOOGLE.TITLE: Google Translate
GOOGLE.NOTE: Translates each message on its own, so short messages can be detected as the wrong language.
GOOGLE.BILLING: Billed separately by Google on your Google Cloud account

UPGRADE.NOTE: Upgrade to a paid plan to translate conversations with Captain or Google Translate.

AUTO_TRANSLATE.TITLE: Auto-translate conversations
AUTO_TRANSLATE.NOTE: Read every message in your language. Customers get replies in theirs.
AUTO_TRANSLATE.LOCKED: Choose a service to turn this on.
AUTO_TRANSLATE.NOT_AVAILABLE: Auto-translate isn't enabled for this account yet.

AUTO_RESOLVE.TITLE: Auto-resolve conversations
AUTO_RESOLVE.NOTE: This configuration would allow you to automatically resolve the conversation after a certain period of inactivity.

DURATION.LABEL: Inactivity duration
DURATION.HELP: Time period of inactivity after which conversation is auto-resolved
DURATION.ERROR: Auto resolve duration should be between {minDuration} minutes and 999 days

API.ERROR: Failed to update auto resolve settings

MESSAGE.LABEL: Custom auto-resolution message
MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: Conversation was marked resolved by system due to 15 days of inactivity
MESSAGE.HELP: Message sent to the customer after conversation is auto-resolved

IGNORE_WAITING.LABEL: Skip conversations waiting for agent’s reply

NAME.LABEL: അക്കൗണ്ടിന്റെ പേര്

AUTO_RESOLVE_IGNORE_WAITING.LABEL: Exclude unattended conversations
AUTO_RESOLVE_IGNORE_WAITING.HELP: When enabled, the system will skip resolving conversations that are still waiting for an agent's reply.

AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION.TITLE: Transcribe Audio Messages
AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION.NOTE: Automatically transcribe audio messages in conversations. Generate a text transcript whenever an audio message is sent or received, and display it alongside the message.

API.ERROR: Failed to update audio transcription setting

ENFORCE_MFA.TITLE: Enforce two-factor authentication
ENFORCE_MFA.NOTE: Require every member of this account to set up two-factor authentication. Members without it will be asked to set it up at their next password sign-in. Sign-ins through Google or SAML are exempt. API access tokens of members who have not set up two-factor authentication stop working for this account until they enrol.

API.ERROR: Failed to update two-factor authentication enforcement

AUTO_RESOLVE_DURATION.LABEL: Inactivity duration for resolution
AUTO_RESOLVE_DURATION.HELP: Duration after a conversation should auto resolve if there is no activity

API.ERROR: Failed to update auto resolve settings

AUTO_RESOLVE_DURATION.MESSAGE_HELP: This message is sent to the customer when a conversation is automatically resolved by the system due to inactivity.
